name: Fujiwara Itsuki
source:
Grade: Elementary school 4th grader.
Room: Tsubomi Dorm, Room 102.
Characteristics:  Itsuki is so active she can be mistaken for a boy. She loves smashing and destroying things at the dorm. But all she really wants is to be noticed as a girl...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
